what: the rasterizer drawing at a size the viewBox does not state
note: `test: null` means the whole suite, and here that is load-bearing twice
over. The additive invariant this ticket is most likely to break lives in
the six `*_raster_test.dart` golden comparisons, not in
`raster_scale_test.dart` — a narrowed run would report a 1:1 regression
as a survivor.
Group A removes the scale from one place at a time. Every one of these is
a *silently wrong picture* rather than a crash, which is the class this
seam exists to stop.
A3 is the one that earned this file. The gradient axis was the only
length in the rasterizer that is neither carried by the matrix nor scaled
at construction, so it was missed on the first pass and the suite was
green. `sunset` at 2x came back 108/255 off across whole interior rows
with every shape exactly where it belonged.
Group B removes a refusal. A non-uniform scale is not a wrong number, it
is a Gaussian that is no longer isotropic — `blurSigma` reads the
matrix's column norms and would silently take one of two blurs.
A5 used to mutate `scale: sx` to `scale: sy` as well. That half was dropped
rather than kept: the guard three lines above throws unless `sx == sy`, so
the two are provably the same value wherever the return is reached, and a
case that cannot die makes the runner's non-zero exit mean nothing. Same
judgement as the two #41 mutants that were retired for surviving by design.
What is left is the swap, which is *not* inert — it feeds the filter
region's -10%/120% default, and only a non-square viewBox can tell.

cases.name: A1 — the shape matrix loses the device scale
A2 — the mask is not scaled
A3 — the gradient axis stays in user units
A4 — the filter region is resolved against the device size
A5 — the viewBox’s two numbers are swapped
cases.from: return (scale: sx, viewWidth: viewWidth, viewHeight: viewHeight);
cases.to: return (scale: sx, viewWidth: viewHeight, viewHeight: viewWidth);

cases.name: B1 — a non-uniform target is accepted
B2 — a non-positive target is accepted
B3 — a viewBox with no extent is accepted
A6 — the stroke outline's discs lose the scaled tolerance
